title: Spin Versus Pace: Mapping Chennai Super Kings’s Batting Trade-Offs
dek: Do Chennai Super Kings score more freely against pace or spin, and what does each cost them in wickets? Bowling-type data since 2022 maps the trade-off.
excerpt: Since 2022 Chennai Super Kings' batting has tracked the league closely against both pace and spin, with no clear weakness for opponents to target.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: CSK struck at {{ev:svp-team-pace-sr}} against pace and {{ev:svp-team-spin-sr}} against spin (2022–2026).
The rest of the IPL struck at {{ev:svp-rest-pace-sr}} and {{ev:svp-rest-spin-sr}} respectively.
Bowling type is known for {{ev:svp-cov}} of deliveries in the window.

sections.heading: Two Different Games
body: Batting against pace and batting against spin reward different skills: one punishes the ball that is too full or too short, the other the ball that is flighted or too flat. Every side has a lean, and opposition analysts look for it first.
CricField attached each bowler's type from player-bio data to every delivery since 2022. Bowling type is known for {{ev:svp-cov}} of balls.

sections.heading: Chennai Super Kings' Lean
body: Against pace, Chennai Super Kings struck at {{ev:svp-team-pace-sr}} and lost a wicket every {{ev:svp-team-pace-bpd}} balls. Against spin they struck at {{ev:svp-team-spin-sr}}, losing a wicket every {{ev:svp-team-spin-bpd}} balls.

The league comparison matters because everyone scores at different rates against the two types: the rest of the IPL struck at {{ev:svp-rest-pace-sr}} against pace and {{ev:svp-rest-spin-sr}} against spin. Relative to that baseline the gaps are small, too small to call a weakness at these sample sizes.

sections.heading: How Opponents Will Plan
body: With no clear weakness, opposition plans are more likely to target individual batters than the line-up as a whole.
The useful work is at player level: each batter's split against pace and spin, tracked season by season.

sections.heading: Type Is Not Everything
body: Pace and spin are broad labels. A left-arm wrist spinner and an off-spinner pose different problems, as do a swing bowler and a hit-the-deck quick. The comparison here also excludes bowlers whose type is unknown.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Balanced, So Plan Batter by Batter
body: Chennai Super Kings have no team-wide weakness by bowling type; the plan should be built around individual match-ups.
Tracking strike rate and balls per dismissal by bowling type each season would show whether the gap is closing.
